verdict.rationale: QuickBooks Payroll ships an embedded 'Payroll AI', so letting users connect MCP servers to that assistant is a fair question for this product. The evidence pack never mentions MCP client support or any way to plug external tool servers into that AI. The developer material (Workforce GraphQL API, webhooks, SDKs, sandbox) consists of developer building blocks for external apps, not MCP client capability, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
